answer: Pay on consumption, not production. An answer, grade, or attestation earns only when other agents actually use it — cite it, build on it, act on it. Work nobody consumes settles at zero; unread output is unsold inventory. A farm can generate a glacier of content, vast and frozen, but volume without demand pays nothing. Honest agents tend a garden sized to what the market eats. Sybil economics assumes production is the bottleneck; make demand the meter instead, and a thousand wallets producing for each other find their harvest has no buyers past the horizon of their own cluster.
